SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. D. REG.
No. S. B. D. 2325
ate 5 - 5 - 31.

May 5, 31.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge
receipt of your letter No.1501 of May 2
regarding a Polish citizen named Chaikowsky,
and to thank you for the information it
contained.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

pages.en:
AT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 1501.

SHANGHAI, 2nd May 1931.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C. & S. REGIST. Vo. S. B. D. 2325. cte 5 - 5 - 31.）

Sir,

With reference to an inquiry I recently made concerning
a Polish citizen CHAIKOWSKY, I have the honour to inform you
that I am now in a position to give a few more particulars
concerning this person.

（批：* See No search in C. & S. Reg. 5/5）

VLADISLAV CHAIKOWSKY was a member of the Iseko Circus, （批：* See S.B. D. 1581）
which left Shanghai for Hongkong in December 1926, and from
there went to Canton in January 1927, returning to Hongkong
in May 1927. From there the circus went to Manilla in Au-
gust 1927 by the s. s. "President Pierce". Whilst in Hongkong
Chaikowsky was in possession of Polish Passport No. 2546, issued
in Harbin. His age was given as 37 and place of birth Grodno.

On the 15th of July 1927 Chaikowsky married a certain Pauline
Herera, of Chinese extraction, born in Lima, Peru. She accompanied
him from Hongkong to Manilla, but returned on her own on 21 April
1928, remaining in Hongkong in more or less destitute conditions
until 9 July 1929, when she left for Peru on the s. s. "Anyo Maru".

According to information from Singapore, Mr. Chaikowsky appeared
to be in Sumatra with the Harmstons Circus in June 1928.

I have not been able to find any record in the archives of this
Consulate General from which it would follow that he applied for
a visé here.

The telegram I received from the Immigration Bureau at Batavia
stated that, according to reports at hand there, Chaikowsky "had
been removed from Shanghai by the British Police", but I think that
this information, apart from being incorrect in so far as it mentions
"the British Police", originally referred to the departure of
Chaikowsky's

R. C. Alers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,

SHANGHAI.
pages.zh:
荷兰驻华中地区总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。
第1501号。

上海，1931年5月2日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局 刑事与特别处登记 编号 S. B. D. 2325. 日期 31年5月5日。）

先生：

关于我近期就波兰公民 CHAIKOWSKY 一事所作的查询，谨此奉告，我现在可以提供有关此人的更多细节。

（批注：* 见刑事与特别处登记中无搜查记录，5月5日）

弗拉迪斯拉夫·柴可夫斯基（VLADISLAV CHAIKOWSKY）曾是伊塞科马戏团（Iseko Circus）的成员，（批注：* 见 S.B. D. 1581）该团于1926年12月离开上海前往香港，随后于1927年1月从香港前往广州，并于1927年5月返回香港。此后，该马戏团于1927年8月乘坐“皮尔斯总统”号轮船（s. s. "President Pierce"）从香港前往马尼拉。在香港期间，柴可夫斯基持有在哈尔滨签发的第2546号波兰护照。其年龄申报为37岁，出生地为格罗德诺（Grodno）。

1927年7月15日，柴可夫斯基与一位名叫宝琳·赫雷拉（Pauline Herera）的女士结婚，她具有中国血统，出生于秘鲁利马。她陪同柴可夫斯基从香港前往马尼拉，但于1928年4月21日独自返回，并在香港处于近乎赤贫的状态下停留至1929年7月9日，当日她乘坐“安洋丸”号轮船（s. s. "Anyo Maru"）离开前往秘鲁。

根据来自新加坡的信息，柴可夫斯基先生似乎于1928年6月在苏门答腊随哈姆斯顿马戏团（Harmstons Circus）活动。

本总领事馆档案中未查得任何记录显示他曾在此申请签证。

我收到来自巴达维亚移民局的一份电报，称根据该局掌握的报告，柴可夫斯基“已被英国警察从上海驱逐出境”，但我认为这一信息除了错误地提及“英国警察”外，原本是指柴可夫斯基的离境

R. C. Alers 先生，
副警务总监，
刑事与特别处，

上海。
